authorship: Codex visual inspection of r0 screenshot; no model generated these critiques
observation: Strong synthwave/pixel identity and excellent perspective highway. The Start label is extremely faint, title dominates too much, and the options/start controls sit low with weak state distinction.

independent_axis_critiques.layout: Reduce title slightly and pull actionable controls into the highway focal flow.
independent_axis_critiques.spacing: Normalize the button row and increase bottom safe margin.
independent_axis_critiques.color_type: Restore Start contrast and define primary/secondary states; retain magenta/cyan/yellow.
independent_axis_critiques.style_orig: Add a restrained hit-line pulse and lane markers, not more decorative glow.

cross_critique_tradeoff: A brighter CTA can compete with the neon title. Use yellow as the small primary action and slightly reduce title glow to balance the hierarchy.
fused_revision: Refine the already strong synthwave composition: make START GAME fully legible and clearly primary, align both controls with comfortable bottom margin, reduce the title/glow slightly, and strengthen the hit line and lane markers so the highway reads as gameplay rather than decoration. Preserve the strict pixel aesthetic and limited magenta/cyan/yellow palette.
axes_moderated_revision: Tighten the title-to-highway hierarchy, pulling the control row into the vanishing-point flow. Equalize button dimensions and safe margins. Use yellow fill/high contrast for Start and an outlined cyan secondary Options state. Improve hit-line and note readability while reducing bloom that softens pixel edges.
mad_moderated_revision: Preserve the dramatic title and grid, but reduce bloom just enough to recover crisp pixel edges. Make a compact yellow Start button the sole primary action beneath the hit line, with a quieter cyan-outline Options button beside it. Strengthen lane separators/hit line without adding more notes or visual effects, and maintain a clear bottom margin.
